Future opportunities depend on project availability and applicable selection criteria.</p> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/imerit-technology-ai-trainer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/imerit-technology-ai-trainer</a></p> Tue, 13 Oct 2026 23:19:00 +0000 Thu, 12 Nov 2026 23:19:00 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/imerit-technology-ai-trainer https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/imerit-technology-ai-trainer Kyro AI: Sales Development Representative Anywhere in the World Alabama Sales Management, Sales, Client Relationship Management, Communication Skills, Client Relations, Sales Enablement, and Stakeholder Communication Sales and Marketing Contract <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6563/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Texas <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://kyro.ai">https://kyro.ai</a> </p> <p>Sales Development Representative (SDR)</p> <p>Location: Remote, non-US based, working US Central Time business hours<br>Experience: 1-3 years in a B2B SDR/BDR role<br>Employment type: Full-time<br>Reports to: Product Manager - Growth</p> <p>ABOUT KYRO AI<br>When a major storm knocks out power, utilities race to mobilize crews and get the lights back on. Kyro AI builds the software behind that effort: workforce and contractor management for electric utilities, storm restoration contractors, and aggregators. We are headquartered in Plano, Texas, and were spun off from Think Power Solutions, so we pair long-standing utility expertise with the pace and ownership of a product company.<br><br><a href="https://kyro.ai/">https://kyro.ai/</a></p> <p>WHY JOIN KYRO<br>- Work that matters: our platform helps communities get power back after storms and keeps a critical, regulated industry compliant.<br>- A growing product suite: StormShield for storm restoration, Kyro Capital for contractor invoice factoring, KORY (our AI copilot), and contractor onboarding and verification.<br>- Credibility from day one: you sell with the backing of real utility relationships and domain know-how.<br>- Close to leadership: direct access to the CEO and product team, and what you hear from customers shapes the roadmap.<br>- Room to grow: a clear path from SDR to Account Executive.<br>- Flexibility: fully remote team.</p> <p>THE ROLE<br>As an SDR, you are the first conversation most utilities and contractors have with Kyro. You will work two segments with very different buying motions:</p> <p>Utilities (enterprise): You will talk to storm response, emergency management, contractor management, supply chain, and procurement leaders. Cycles are long, involve multiple stakeholders, and are often tied to RFIs/RFPs. A win is a qualified discovery meeting or demo handed to the account team.</p> <p>Contractors (SMB to mid-market): You will talk to owners, operations managers, and storm coordinators at line, vegetation, and restoration contractors. Cycles are shorter, phone-first, and owner-led. A win is a demo held and the contractor signed up and onboarded.</p> <p>WHAT YOU'LL DO<br>- Prospect outbound: research target utilities and contractors, build account lists, and reach decision-makers by phone, email, and LinkedIn.<br>- Own the follow-up: run multi-touch cadences, chase no-shows and stalled conversations, and make sure every lead has a dated next step.<br>- Respond to inbound leads the same business day and qualify them before they go cold.<br>- Qualify with rigor: confirm need, timeline, decision process, budget, and compliance requirements before booking.<br>- Book and confirm demos, send reminders, and hand off with clear notes.<br>- Drive conversions: stay with contractors after the demo until they sign up and start onboarding; keep utility opportunities moving to the next stage.<br&
